name: MCP Playwright
description: Headless Chromium browser with DOM snapshots for AI-driven browsing. Navigate, snapshot interactive elements, click by index, type, screenshot, extract text, execute JS.

mcp_browser_goto.description: Navigate browser to a URL. Returns page title and final URL.

mcp_browser_snapshot.description: Get a compact list of ALL interactive page elements (buttons, links, inputs) with index numbers. Use this before clicking/typing to identify target elements. Returns: [1] BUTTON 'Log in', [2] INPUT 'Email', etc.

mcp_browser_click.description: Click an element. Accepts: snapshot index like [1] or 1, CSS selector like #login-btn, or visible text like 'Log in'.

parameters.selector: Index number [N], CSS selector, or visible text

mcp_browser_type.description: Type text into an input field by snapshot index or CSS selector.

mcp_browser_screenshot.description: Capture a full-page screenshot. Saves to /tmp/suijin_screenshot.png by default.

mcp_browser_extract.description: Extract visible text content from a specific element or the full page body.

parameters.selector: CSS selector or 'body' for full page (default body)

mcp_browser_exec.description: Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the page context. Returns JSON result.

mcp_browser_get_html.description: Get the full rendered HTML source of the current page.

mcp_browser_close.description: Close the browser instance and free resources.

mcp_browser_requests.description: Read captured network traffic (requests + responses with bodies). Start capture with mcp_browser_net_start first.

mcp_browser_net_start.description: Start capturing all network traffic the page makes. Use before navigating to catch API calls, tokens, internal endpoints.

mcp_browser_net_stop.description: Stop network capture (entries retained until read).

mcp_browser_cookies.description: Read all cookies, or set/delete a specific one. Cookie object: {name, value, domain, path}.

mcp_browser_storage.description: Inspect localStorage/sessionStorage. Read all keys, read one, or set one.

mcp_browser_intercept.description: Intercept requests matching a URL pattern. Actions: block, modify (set headers), passthrough. Essential for testing CSP, removing security headers, blocking scripts.

mcp_browser_tab_open.description: Open a new browser tab (optionally navigate). For testing window.open, popups, multi-origin flows.

mcp_browser_tab_switch.description: Switch the active tab by ID.

mcp_browser_console.description: Read captured JS console output — errors reveal internal service names, stack traces, API endpoints.

mcp_browser_wait.description: Smart wait: for a selector to appear/be visible/hidden, or a fixed delay in ms.

mcp_browser_auth_save.description: Save the current browser auth state (cookies + localStorage) to reuse across engagements or restore after navigation.

mcp_browser_auth_restore.description: Restore a previously saved auth state — login once, test across many pages.

mcp_browser_shadow.description: Shadow-DOM-aware element query/click/type — pierces ALL shadow roots automatically. Actions: text (query), click, type.

mcp_browser_fingerprint.description: Current page fingerprint: frameworks in use, storage state, CSP, WebSocket/fetch availability, user agent.
